# Builds the standalone speex resampler (the only part of speexdsp that
# dosbox-staging uses) as a static library named `speexdsp`, for platforms
# without pkg-config (HarmonyOS/OHOS embed builds).
#
# Set SPEEXDSP_SRC to the root of the speexdsp source tree before calling
# add_subdirectory() on this directory.
#
# The resampler is built in floating-point mode, outside the speex codec
# tree, with all symbols renamed via RANDOM_PREFIX.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

if(NOT SPEEXDSP_SRC)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "SPEEXDSP_SRC (path to the speexdsp source tree) is required")
endif()

# The upstream tree only ships speexdsp_config_types.h.in (it is normally
# generated by the autotools build); generate it for this build.
set(INCLUDE_STDINT "#include <stdint.h>")
set(SIZE16 int16_t)
set(USIZE16 uint16_t)
set(SIZE32 int32_t)
set(USIZE32 uint32_t)
set(SPEEXDSP_CONFIG_TYPES_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/speex")
configure_file(
  "${SPEEXDSP_SRC}/include/speex/speexdsp_config_types.h.in"
  "${SPEEXDSP_CONFIG_TYPES_DIR}/speexdsp_config_types.h"
  @ONLY
)

add_library(speexdsp STATIC
  "${SPEEXDSP_SRC}/libspeexdsp/resample.c"
)

target_include_directories(speexdsp
  PUBLIC
    "${SPEEXDSP_SRC}/include"
    # generated speexdsp_config_types.h; consumed by speexdsp_types.h which
    # dosbox's mixer pulls in through <speex/speex_resampler.h>
    "${SPEEXDSP_CONFIG_TYPES_DIR}"
  PRIVATE
    "${SPEEXDSP_SRC}/include/speex"
    "${SPEEXDSP_SRC}/libspeexdsp"
)

target_compile_definitions(speexdsp PRIVATE
  OUTSIDE_SPEEX
  RANDOM_PREFIX=dosbox_staging
  FLOATING_POINT
  EXPORT=
  HAVE_STDINT_H
)

target_link_libraries(speexdsp PRIVATE m)
